description_full:
Our Business and Entrepreneurship Summer Career Camp enables you to gain real world experiences in the world of business. From branding, marketing and finance to operations, pitching and IPOs, discover how to start your own business from the ground up. Through immersive, hands-on practical workshops, networking opportunities and visits to top London businesses you will gain an in-depth understanding of the life of an entrepreneur.

Our Business and Entrepreneurship Summer Career Camp covers key areas of business, including operations, marketing, branding and pitch proposals. Students gain practical experience through industry workshops such as the Innocent Smoothie Lab, building disruptive business models with Airbnb and visits to the London Academy of Trading.

Business students will engage with seasoned mentors, exploring high-stakes decision-making and risk management. Gain expert insights into global economics and the strategic technical analysis essential for entrepreneurial success.

This immersive careers & life skills programme includes hands-on, practical workshops to teach you career and life skills, with visits to top professionals in areas like personal branding, public speaking, and CV writing. You’ll also explore financial literacy and leadership development.

description_short: Practical workshops and industry visits designed to teach you key chemical engineering concepts.
description_full:
The Chemical Engineering Summer Career Camp for students aged 15–18 offers hands-on experience in chemical processes, industrial engineering, and laboratory-based learning. Students explore how raw materials are transformed into useful products through real-world experiments, simulations, and practical workshops. The programme also includes UCAS support, personal statement guidance, and career mentoring for future chemical engineering and STEM pathways.

The Chemical Engineering Summer Career Camp introduces students to the fundamentals of chemical engineering through practical, lab-based learning and real-world applications. Students explore topics such as chemical reactions, process design, material transformation, energy systems, and industrial production. Through guided experiments and structured workshops, students understand how chemical engineers design and improve large-scale processes. The programme also develops problem-solving, analytical thinking, and teamwork skills. Alongside technical learning, students receive UCAS support and university preparation guidance to help them progress into chemical engineering degrees and STEM careers.

curriculum_sections.title: Materials and Industrial Chemistry
curriculum_sections.body: Understand how raw materials are transformed into usable products in industries such as energy, pharmaceuticals, and manufacturing.

curriculum_sections.title: Laboratory Skills and Experimentation
curriculum_sections.body: Students take part in supervised lab-based experiments to develop technical and analytical scientific skills.

Creative Writing Summer Career Camp is an immersive programme for students aged 15–18 passionate about storytelling, poetry, screenwriting, and publishing. It offers workshops, projects, and mentorship from writers. Students develop skills in fiction, journalism, editing, and narrative structure, build portfolios, and receive university application support and personalised feedback guidance certificate.

The Creative Writing Summer Career Camp is a structured programme combining academic learning with practical writing experience. Students engage in workshops, writing challenges, and collaborative activities that reflect real creative environments. They learn how to develop characters, structure narratives, create emotional impact, and communicate ideas across genres. The course also covers editing, publishing, storytelling techniques, and audience engagement while building skills in creativity, communication, teamwork, and critical thinking. Alongside writing practice, students receive university support including personal statements, portfolio development, interview preparation, and academic mentoring. This blend of creativity and academic guidance prepares students for future study and creative writing careers.

description_short: Hands-on, practical experience in the field of criminology
description_full:
The Criminology Summer Career Camp is a practical, immersive programme for students aged 15–18 who are curious about crime, law, forensic science, and criminal psychology. This programme blends academic theory, hands-on activities, and career guidance, giving students a true insight into criminology and the criminal justice system. Students leaving this camp will gain real investigative skills, university-ready experience, and a competitive edge for future criminology and law applications.

Early exposure to criminology, forensic science, and law enforcement

Practical problem-solving experience in real-life criminal investigations

A strong foundation for university applications and career planning

Networking opportunities with professionals, guest speakers, and mentors

Whether aiming for a degree in criminology, forensic psychology, law, or criminal justice, this camp helps students clarify their goals and develop essential skills.

curriculum_sections.title: Central Criminal Court, The Old Bailey
curriculum_sections.body: Witness the legal system in action as you observe real trials, explore historic courtrooms, and gain unprecedented insight into UK criminal proceedings.

curriculum_sections.title: Criminal Psychology and Behaviour Analysis
curriculum_sections.body: Explore the psychological and social factors behind criminal behaviour while learning how criminologists analyse motives, patterns, and behavioural trends. Students gain insight into criminal profiling, deception detection, and psychological approaches within criminal investigations.

curriculum_sections.title: Digital Forensics and Cybercrime
curriculum_sections.body: Participants are introduced to digital investigations and cybercrime analysis, learning how technology is used to investigate online criminal activity and digital evidence in modern law enforcement environments.

curriculum_sections.title: Investigative Skills and Case Analysis
curriculum_sections.body: Students strengthen critical thinking and problem-solving skills through real-life case studies, group investigations, and structured evidence analysis exercises. These activities help students understand how investigators evaluate information and build criminal cases.

curriculum_sections.title: University and Career Preparation
curriculum_sections.body: Students receive guidance on university applications, personal statements, criminology degree pathways, and interview preparation. Workshops help students understand future careers in criminology, forensic science, psychology, law enforcement, and criminal justice.

curriculum_sections.title: Research Project and Personalised Feedback
curriculum_sections.body: Students complete an independent criminology research project designed to develop investigative, academic, and analytical skills. Tutors provide personalised written feedback to help students improve their critical thinking, research techniques, and report-writing abilities.

curriculum_sections.title: 1 week · Rising Talent
curriculum_sections.body: The Origins of Criminological Thought • Criminology Academic Study • The Origins of Confinement • London Dungeon • Central Criminal Court • PLUS: Choose another career week OR Career & Life Skills

curriculum_sections.title: 2 weeks · Career Explorer
curriculum_sections.body: Plus: Week 1 • Human Rights • Whitestone Chambers • International Law Applied • Mock Trial • Debate: Human Rights

curriculum_sections.title: 3 weeks · Future Leader
curriculum_sections.body: Week 1 • Another related career week • Career & Life Skills Week • Professional Networking

The Engineering Summer Career Camp for students aged 15–18 offers hands-on experience in mechanical, civil, electrical, and structural engineering. Students take part in real engineering challenges, practical workshops, and design-based projects that reflect real-world industry problems. The programme also includes UCAS support, personal statement guidance, and career mentoring to prepare students for top engineering degrees and future STEM careers.

The Engineering Summer Career Camp introduces students to the core principles of engineering through practical, project-based learning. Students explore how engineers design, build, and improve systems in areas such as mechanics, structures, electricity, and materials. Through hands-on workshops, team challenges, and real-world problem-solving activities, students gain insight into how engineering is applied in industry. The programme also develops key skills in analysis, design thinking, teamwork, and communication. Alongside technical learning, students receive UCAS support and university preparation guidance to help them progress into engineering degrees and careers.

description_short: Immersive workshops to teach you international relations skills, including industry visits.
description_full:
The International Relations Summer Career Camp is for students aged 15–18 interested in global politics, diplomacy, law, economics, and world affairs. Through workshops, debates, simulations, and expert-led sessions, students explore international careers, develop analytical and leadership skills, and receive UCAS support, including personal statements and future university guidance planning support.

The International Relations Summer Career Camp introduces students to global politics and diplomacy through practical learning and academic exploration. Students study how governments and organisations address issues like climate change, conflict, migration, security, trade, and human rights. The programme combines university-level study with real-world experiences, including Model United Nations, political simulations, and debates. Participants develop critical thinking, communication, leadership, and teamwork skills while exploring careers in diplomacy, international law, politics, and global affairs. They also receive guidance for university applications and future pathways. Overall, it builds confidence and a strong understanding of international relations and global decision-making processes.

description_short: Hands-on, industry visits to top solicitor firms, chambers and court rooms.
description_full:
The Law Summer Career Camp is a hands-on programme for students aged 15–18 exploring careers in law. Students gain practical experience through mock trials, legal workshops, debates, and court simulations while developing advocacy, research, and analytical skills. The camp also includes UCAS, LNAT, and interview preparation with expert mentor guidance.

The Law Summer Career Camp is a structured and immersive programme combining academic legal theory with hands-on legal experience for students aged 15–18. Through interactive workshops, mock trials, legal simulations, and group activities, students explore how legal professionals analyse evidence, build arguments, and present cases in realistic courtroom settings. Participants develop essential transferable skills including communication, leadership, teamwork, critical thinking, and problem-solving while gaining insight into legal systems and ethical issues. The programme also provides expert university preparation support through UCAS guidance, personal statement workshops, LNAT preparation, and interview coaching, helping students understand both academic pathways and future careers within the legal profession.

description_short: Explores higher-level maths through hands-on workshops and industry visits.
description_full:
This maths work experience programme explores higher-level mathematics through hands-on workshops, covering topics like set theory, proofs, vector spaces, and infinity, while enhancing problem-solving and analytical skills.

With the number of applicants for maths-related degrees and careers growing each year, standing out is more important than ever. How can you demonstrate your passion for mathematics? Our 5-day programme in London will help you showcase your enthusiasm and strengthen your chances of securing a spot at a top university or advancing your career in mathematics.

Physics Summer Career Camp for students aged 15–18 offers hands-on experience in physics, space science, engineering principles, and scientific problem-solving. curriculum_sections.title: Data Science and Computational Thinking
curriculum_sections.body: Students explore data analysis, logical reasoning, and computational thinking, learning how professionals use data to solve real-world problems effectively.

curriculum_sections.title: Industry Research Project and Personalised Feedback
curriculum_sections.body: Students complete an independent technology research project designed to strengthen technical understanding, analytical thinking, and project development skills. Tutors provide personalised written feedback to support academic development and future university preparation.

curriculum_sections.title: Technology Innovation and Industry Exploration
curriculum_sections.body: Students join a coding workshop using Python, learning variables, loops, functions, and algorithms through FizzBuzz and interactive game projects.

curriculum_sections.title: 1 week · Rising Talent
curriculum_sections.body: Algorithmic Thinking and What is Computer Science • Game Development • The World of Artificial Intelligence • Website Development • Data Structures and Algorithms • UCAS Application & Personal Statement

curriculum_sections.title: 2 weeks · Career Explorer
curriculum_sections.body: Computer Architecture • Introduction to Python • AI and 'Vibe Coding' • Encryption and Codebreaking • Cybersecurity

curriculum_sections.title: 3 weeks · Future Leader
curriculum_sections.body: 1 week experience • 2 week experience • Career & Life Skills • Professional Networking
